canada.title: Philpot-Ford matchup an intriguing one in Grey Cup
canada.summary: Football is a game of matchups, and the Grey Cup on Sunday will present no shortage of them.

canada.title: Woman arrested after allegedly impersonating officer at Remembrance Day ceremony
canada.summary: VANCOUVER - A woman has been arrested and charged after allegedly impersonating a police officer during Vancouver's Remembrance Day ceremony.

canada.title: Manitoba health-care unions want stronger response to increasing workplace violence
canada.summary: Two health-care unions are calling on labour regulators to treat violent events at hospitals the same way they treat high-risk industrial and construction jobs.

canada.title: Saskatoon police officer who was hit by vehicle stable, still in hospital
canada.summary: The Saskatoon police officer who was stuck by a vehicle on Wednesday afternoon is still undergoing treatment in hospital, but is now stable, SPS Chief Cameron McBride said.

canada.title: Overlapping pool closures will worsen swimming lesson scheduling crunch
canada.summary: A delay in reopening Seven Oaks Pool will make it even tougher for Winnipeggers to secure swimming lessons, with its repair now set to overlap a major closure at another city pool.

canada.title: City orders removal of smaller Saskatoon encampment on 20th Street
canada.summary: Station 20 West says that despite warning from fire department to address an encampment on its property by Nov. 27, the organization, which helps unhoused people, has no intention of helping to displace about 30 people living in tents.

canada.title: Program that supports seniors living at home expands in rural New Brunswick
canada.summary: A new program in rural New Brunswick is bringing some of the benefits of a nursing home directly to the community.

canada.title: A PAL Airlines flight lost a wheel less than 2 weeks ago. It's happened again — to the same plane
canada.summary: Less than two weeks after a PAL Airlines flight lost a wheel, the airline has confirmed the same plane lost another one Thursday. Flight 411 was bound for Deer Lake, Newfoundland and Labrador, but instead landed in St. John's.

canada.title: New Brunswick auditor general to retire at year’s end
canada.summary: New Brunswick Auditor General Paul Martin has announced his retirement from the job after completing five years of his 10-year term.

canada.title: Indigenous women's groups call out Ottawa over funding in new federal budget
canada.summary: Indigenous women’s groups say the new federal budget is harming the people they represent by not including funding targeted at violence and community support services.

canada.title: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne says Canada can build energy for AI, as Canadians protest against data centres, Bill C-39
canada.summary: Champagne was in Halifax on Thursday for an event with the Halifax Chamber of Commerce.

canada.title: Gov't workers from Yukon, N.W.T., among private-sector staff heading to major projects office
canada.summary: The major projects office has seconded employees from banks, oil and gas companies and mining firms as it pursues its mandate to improve Canada's review process and get shovels in the ground faster.

canada.title: Report of children confined in locker at Quebec school draws minister's condemnation
canada.summary: Students at a primary school were allegedly placed in a metal locker as a disciplinary measure. The Education Ministry is in touch with the investigating authorities to better understand what took place.

canada.title: Shelter-in-place advisory issued for Pemberton Valley, parts of Squamish as flooding closes roads
canada.summary: Shelter-in-place advisories have been issued in the Pemberton Valley and parts of the District of Squamish as flooding threatens local properties and roads. Líl̓wat Nation expanded an evacuation order for its community Thursday morning.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News + APTN News, CP24

canada.title: Halifax-area teacher charged in child luring investigation
canada.summary: A 33-year-old man has been charged in connection with a child luring investigation. Police say they believe there are other victims who were targeted online.

canada.title: Pilot killed in plane crash during Remembrance Day event in Quebec
canada.summary: More details are emerging about the plane crash that killed a 68-year-old pilot during a Remembrance Day ceremony Wednesday morning in Saint-Georges-de-Beauce, Que.

canada.title: Jewelry store robbery ring that wreaked havoc this year dismantled, say Montreal police
canada.summary: Police arrested 16 individuals on Wednesday suspected of orchestrating a series of smash-and-grab robberies committed by groups of youths at jewelry stores in the Montreal area in the past year.

canada.title: Alberta man charged with luring, sexually exploiting B.C. girl he met on gaming platform
canada.summary: A 19-year-old Alberta man is facing multiple charges, including child luring and child sexual exploitation, following an investigation into his alleged interactions with a British Columbia girl on an online gaming platform.

desks.title: Democrat Cindy Holscher wins election for governor in Kansas
desks.summary: Democrat Cindy Holscher won election Thursday as governor of Kansas, defeating Republican Ty Masterson. Holscher's win will keep the governor's office under Democratic control after the departure of term-limited Gov. Laura Kelly. The victory also breaks a 60-year streak in Kansas of electing governors from the party opposite that of their immediate predecessors. Holscher, a state senator since 2021, focused on affordability issues while also promising to institute a temporary moratorium on building new data centers. Masterson, the state Senate president, ran with the backing of President Donald Trump. The Associated Press declared Holscher the winner at 5:43 p.m. EST.

bds.h: Nvidia sell-off continues after CEO Jensen Huang steps down
bds.lede: Shares of Nvidia, the chipmaker at the centre of the global artificial intelligence boom, tumbled Thursday with the sudden departure of CEO Jensen Huang following revelations of an affair with a woman reported to be a suspected Chinese spy.
rows: PBS NewsHour

Nvidia announced Huang's resignation on Thursday, effective immediately. The California-based company said that Colette Kress — who has been Nvidia's chief financial officer and executive vice president since 2013 — will step into the role of interim CEO.
CBS News
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned effective immediately, the company's board of directors announced Thursday.
The Guardian
Move follows admission of affair with woman alleged to be Chinese spy and reported relationships with two employees
NBC News

Jensen Huang, who once led the most valuable company in the world, resigned from his post as Nvidia CEO today after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang had co-founded Nvidia in 1993, and it became a juggernaut making the chips underpinning much of the AI boom.
ABC News
While the depths of the scandal have yet to be disclosed, here is a timeline indicating who knew what and when about Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
Euronews

Speaking at Web Summit Lisbon, one economist calls founder Jensen Huang’s exit “a critical mistake” and a “significant loss” for the industry, while another says large corporations are built to outlast the people who run them.
